import hashlib

import pathlib

OUT = pathlib.Path('/tmp/iprop-v05-repros')
FROZEN = pathlib.Path('/Users/jakubczachor/.codex/scratch/iprop-v0.4-baseline-20261005')
TOOLS = FROZEN / 'release-tools'
cases = []


def add(identifier, task, source, expected, note='', files=None, equivalent=None):
    cases.append({'id': identifier, 'task': task, 'entry': 'entry.ips',
                  'sources': {'entry.ips': source, **(files or {})},
                  'v05_expectation': {'compile': expected, 'note': note},
                  **({'equivalent_to': equivalent} if equivalent else {})})


def asset(declarations='', draw='', helper=''):
    return f'asset t {{ size 8x8 {declarations} draw {{ {draw} }} {helper} }}\n'


branch = 'asset branch { size 8x8 draw { } }\n'
for token, name in (('<', 'lt'), ('<=', 'le'), ('>', 'gt'), ('>=', 'ge')):
    add('A1_' + name + '_right_shift', '05-A.1',
        asset('output point result', f'value=1 bits=2 result={{value {token} 1 << bits,0}}'),
        'pass', 'RHS uses shift precedence; bit-exact result matches parenthesized form.',
        equivalent='A1_' + name + '_parenthesized')
    add('A1_' + name + '_parenthesized', '05-A.1',
        asset('output point result', f'value=1 bits=2 result={{value {token} (1 << bits),0}}'), 'pass')
add('A1_left_and_right_shift', '05-A.1', asset('output point result', 'result={1 << 2 < 1 << 3,0}'), 'pass')
add('A1_chain_left_associative', '05-A.1', asset('output point result', 'result={0 < 1 < 2,0}'), 'pass', 'Existing left-associative comparison chaining remains accepted.')

for name, value in [('negative_f32', '-0.5'), ('negative_zero', '-0.0'),
                    ('parenthesized_f32', '(0.5)'), ('parenthesized_minus', '(-0.5)'),
                    ('minus_parentheses', '-(0.5)'), ('negative_integer_f32', '-1')]:
    add('A2_' + name, '05-A.2', asset(f'input f32 amount={value} output point result', 'result={amount,0}'), 'pass', 'Preserve resolved binary32 default, including the sign of zero.')
add('A2_signed_integer_palette', '05-A.2', asset('palette p=[-1,0,1] output point result', 'result={p[0],p[2]}'), 'pass')
add('A2_signed_float_palette', '05-A.2', asset('palette p=[-0.0,-0.5,1.0] output point result', 'result={p[0],p[1]}'), 'pass')
add('A2_expression_default', '05-A.2', asset('input f32 amount=(1+2)'), 'reject', 'Default constants intentionally exclude arbitrary binary expressions.')
add('A2_call_default', '05-A.2', asset('input f32 amount=unit()'), 'reject', 'Default resolution must not consume RNG.')
add('A2_double_negation_default', '05-A.2', asset('input f32 amount=--1.0'), 'reject', 'The plan permits one unary minus, not arbitrary unary expressions.')
add('A2_signed_part_default', '05-A.2', 'import branch from "branch.ips"\n' + asset('output point result', 'branch.draw(0,0,0,at={0,0}) result=branch.outputs.anchor'), 'pass', files={'branch.ips': asset('input f32 amount=-0.5 output point anchor', 'anchor={amount,0}')})

for name, palette in [('mixed_int_first', '[0,0.5,1]'), ('mixed_float_first', '[0.5,0,1]'),
                      ('mixed_signed', '[-1,0.5,1]'), ('all_integers', '[0,1,2]'),
                      ('legacy_booleans', '[true,0,false]')]:
    add('A3_' + name, '05-A.3', asset(f'palette p={palette} output point result', 'result={p[0],p[1]}'), 'pass')
add('A3_mixed_ramp', '05-A.3', asset('palette p=[0,0.5,1] output point result', 'result={ramp(p,0.5),0}'), 'pass')
add('A3_integer_ramp', '05-A.3', asset('palette p=[0,1,2]', 'ramp(p,0.5)'), 'reject', 'A pure integer palette stays integer and ramp still rejects it.')
add('A3_color_and_integer', '05-A.3', asset('palette p=[#fff,1]'), 'reject')
add('A3_color_and_float', '05-A.3', asset('palette p=[0.5,#fff]'), 'reject')

for name, value, expected in [('zero', '0', 'pass'), ('positive', '7', 'pass'),
                              ('maximum', '2147483647', 'pass'), ('minimum', '-2147483648', 'pass'),
                              ('negative', '-1', 'pass'), ('positive_overflow', '2147483648', 'reject'),
                              ('negative_overflow', '-2147483649', 'reject'), ('hex_u32_overflow', '0xffffffff', 'reject')]:
    add('A4_i32_' + name, '05-A.4', asset(f'input i32 amount={value} output point result', 'result={amount,0}'), expected,
        'Check the mathematical signed default range before wrapping; the binary input type remains u32.')
add('A4_legacy_u32_max', '05-A.4', asset('input u32 amount=0xffffffff output point result', 'result={amount,0}'), 'pass', 'Unsigned binary bits retain their current signed draw meaning (-1).')
add('A4_negative_u32', '05-A.4', asset('input u32 amount=-1'), 'reject', 'Suggest input i32; do not silently change legacy u32 default rules.')
for override in (False, True):
    call = 'branch.draw(0,0,0,at={0,0}' + (',amount=-1)' if override else ')')
    add('A4_part_' + ('override' if override else 'default'), '05-A.4', 'import branch from "branch.ips"\n' + asset('output point result', call + ' result=branch.outputs.anchor'), 'pass', files={'branch.ips': asset('input i32 amount=-2147483648 output point anchor', 'anchor={amount,0}')})

for name, declaration in [('size', 'size 8x8'), ('origin', 'size 8x8 origin 0,0'),
                           ('variants', 'size 8x8 variants 1'), ('archetypes', 'size 8x8 archetypes 1'),
                           ('input', 'size 8x8 input f32 amount=0.5'), ('output', 'size 8x8 output point result'),
                           ('palette', 'size 8x8 palette p=[0,1]')]:
    add('A5_' + name + '_semicolon', '05-A.5', f'asset t {{ {declaration}; draw {{ }} }}\n', 'pass')
add('A5_import_semicolon', '05-A.5', 'import branch from "branch.ips";\n' + asset(), 'pass', files={'branch.ips': branch})
add('A5_all_declarations', '05-A.5', 'import branch from "branch.ips";\nasset t { size 8x8; origin 0,0; variants 1; archetypes 1; input f32 amount=0.5; output point result; palette p=[0,1]; draw { result={amount,0}; } }\n', 'pass', files={'branch.ips': branch})
add('A5_legacy_no_semicolons', '05-A.5', 'import branch from "branch.ips"\n' + asset('origin 0,0 variants 1 archetypes 1 input f32 amount=0.5 output point result palette p=[0,1]', 'result={amount,0}'), 'pass', files={'branch.ips': branch})
add('A5_no_automatic_argument_separator', '05-A.5', asset(draw='range(1\n2)'), 'reject', 'Newline remains whitespace, not a comma or automatic terminator.')

paint = 'paint(tint:color,x:i32) { pixel(x,0,tint) }'
for name, call, expected in [('named', 'paint(tint=#9dc,x=2)', 'pass'),
                              ('reversed', 'paint(x=2,tint=#9dc)', 'pass'),
                              ('positional', 'paint(#9dc,2)', 'pass'),
                              ('mixed', 'paint(#9dc,x=2)', 'pass'),
                              ('unknown', 'paint(colour=#9dc,x=2)', 'reject'),
                              ('duplicate', 'paint(tint=#9dc,tint=#fff)', 'reject'),
                              ('positional_duplicate', 'paint(#9dc,tint=#fff)', 'reject'),
                              ('missing', 'paint(tint=#9dc)', 'reject'),
                              ('wrong_type', 'paint(tint=1,x=2)', 'reject')]:
    add('C_helper_' + name, '05-C.1/05-C.2', asset(draw=call, helper=paint), expected,
        equivalent='C_helper_positional' if name in ('named', 'reversed', 'mixed') else None)
for name, call, expected in [('named', 'branch.draw(seed=0,v=0,a=0,at={0,0})', 'pass'),
                              ('positional', 'branch.draw(0,0,0,at={0,0})', 'pass'),
                              ('mixed', 'branch.draw(0,v=0,a=0,at={0,0})', 'pass'),
                              ('duplicate_seed', 'branch.draw(0,0,0,seed=7,at={0,0})', 'reject'),
                              ('unknown', 'branch.draw(0,0,0,unknown=1,at={0,0})', 'reject'),
                              ('missing_at', 'branch.draw(seed=0,v=0,a=0)', 'reject'),
                              ('duplicate_at', 'branch.draw(0,0,0,at={0,0},at={1,1})', 'reject'),
                              ('duplicate_transform', 'branch.draw(0,0,0,at={0,0},rot=0,rot=90)', 'reject')]:

    _fields_=[('width',c.c_uint32),('height',c.c_uint32),('pixels',c.POINTER(c.c_uint8)),('output_count',c.c_uint32),('outputs',c.POINTER(Output))]

        outputs.append({'name':o.name.decode(),'owner':o.owner,'kind':o.kind,'is_list':o.is_list,'count':o.count,'float_bits':list((c.c_uint32*(o.count*width)).from_buffer_copy(raw))})
    return {'size':[image.width,image.height],'rgba_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pixels).hexdigest(),'pixel0':list(pixels[:4]),'outputs':outputs}

]:
